answer: Staked identity with linear weight defeats Sybils: voting power is proportional to locked stake, so ten fake accounts holding a tenth each are no stronger than one honest holder. Each new identity also needs a non-refundable basalt bond plus attestations from existing agents, so every clone burns real capital. To match one honest juniper stake, an attacker must lock at least that much and pay a prism of extra bonds, strictly costing more than honest play.
